cells.label: Customer-Support Agent (Apparel) — Production Architecture for Real-Money Actions

Channel: CLI / API
One command:
customer ID or guest email + message

Policy & Knowledge
Versioned policies, product catalog,
ASSUMPTIONS.md decisions
(grounding, no invented policy)
cells.html:
Policy & Knowledge
Versioned policies, product catalog,
ASSUMPTIONS.md decisions
(grounding, no invented policy)

cells.label:
Agent Orchestrator (LLM tool-calling loop)
Understands intent, gathers facts via tools, drafts reply.
Model API key from environment variable. Bounded steps, timeouts,
temperature 0, structured tool calls only
cells.html:
Agent Orchestrator (LLM tool-calling loop)
Understands intent, gathers facts via tools, drafts reply.
Model API key from environment variable. Bounded steps, timeouts,
temperature 0, structured tool calls only

cells.label:
Agent Outcomes
Answer · Clarify (missing order / item /
reason) · Propose action · Escalate
cells.html:
Agent Outcomes
Answer · Clarify (missing order / item /
reason) · Propose action · Escalate

cells.label: 3. Tool Layer (typed schemas, validated arguments)

Read Tools
lookup_order · get_customer · get_product · get_policy
Ownership-checked, timeouts + limited retries.
Fault injection: env flag (e.g. ORDER_LOOKUP_FAIL=1) forces lookup failure
→ fail closed: no money action, apologise + escalate
cells.html:
Read Tools
lookup_order · get_customer · get_product · get_policy
Ownership-checked, timeouts + limited retries.
Fault injection: env flag (e.g. ORDER_LOOKUP_FAIL=1) forces lookup failure
→ fail closed: no money action, apologise + escalate

cells.label:
Write Tools (proposals only)
propose_refund · propose_exchange · propose_cancellation · escalate_to_human
Each call is a request handed to the Money Gate —
the LLM cannot call the payment system directly
cells.html:
Write Tools (proposals only)
propose_refund · propose_exchange · propose_cancellation · escalate_to_human
Each call is a request handed to the Money Gate —
the LLM cannot call the payment system directly

cells.label: 4. Deterministic Money Gate — plain code, not LLM (fail closed)

Policy Engine
• Order belongs to this customer
• Return ≤ 30 days from delivery
• Sale item → exchange only;
  refund only if defective
• Cancel only before shipment
cells.html:
Policy Engine
• Order belongs to this customer
• Return ≤ 30 days from delivery
• Sale item → exchange only;
  refund only if defective
• Cancel only before shipment

cells.label:
Risk & Limits
• Amount ≤ paid − already refunded
  (computed from order, never from LLM)
• Refund cap / velocity limits
• Unverified defect claim, high value,
  abuse signals → human
cells.html:
Risk & Limits
• Amount ≤ paid − already refunded
  (computed from order, never from LLM)
• Refund cap / velocity limits
• Unverified defect claim, high value,
  abuse signals → human

cells.label:
Idempotency & Duplicate Check
Key = order + item + action.
Already done → return existing
result, never pay twice.
Conflicting prior action → deny
cells.html:
Idempotency & Duplicate Check

Already done → return existing
result, never pay twice.
Conflicting prior action → deny

cells.label:
Decision
ALLOW → execute
DENY → explain + offer allowed
alternative (e.g. exchange)
NEEDS HUMAN → escalate
cells.html:
Decision
ALLOW → execute
DENY → explain + offer allowed
alternative (e.g. exchange)

cells.label: 5. Execution & State

State Store / Ledger (durable DB)
Sessions, orders, actions ledger,
idempotency keys, escalations.
Persists between calls
cells.html:

Refund to original payment method,
